body_markdown:
***Liam Feeney takes on key role to support clients in delivering the critical grid upgrades needed for the energy transition***


**LONDON** (October 14, 2026) — AECOM, the trusted global infrastructure leader, today announced it has appointed Liam Feeney as Transmission and Distribution Lead for Europe and India. In this role, Mr. Feeney will lead and grow the organisation’s transmission and distribution team across the region, supporting clients in delivering the network upgrades and expansions needed to meet growing energy demand while enhancing the capacity, resilience and reliability of future power grids.


With extensive experience across the power sector, Mr. Feeney joins from PSC, where he was general manager for power networks and HVDC, leading teams across Europe and North America. He began his career at National Grid, where he helped shape the asset strategy for its HVDC interconnector portfolio, and has also held positions at SSE, where he led the management and operation of 2GWs of onshore wind across Great Britain and Ireland.


Eloise John, Managing Director, Energy, Europe and India, AECOM, said: “Liam joins us at an important time for the business as we continue to work with clients to modernise and expand the networks that will underpin a more sustainable, secure and resilient future. With extensive experience in asset management and operations, Liam is ideally suited to help clients unlock greater value from their assets and navigate the evolving energy landscape.”


Liam Feeney, Transmission and Distribution Lead, Europe and India, AECOM, said: “The energy transition presents one of the most exciting opportunities our industry has seen in a generation. With its deep technical expertise, AECOM is well positioned to help shape the future of energy infrastructure for our clients, and I am thrilled to be joining the business at such an exciting time. I am passionate about supporting the next generation of talent and providing them with real-world experience in project delivery, and I look forward to working with colleagues across the business to help people build rewarding and successful careers.”


Mr. Feeney’s appointment comes as AECOM continues to support clients on some of the region’s most significant transmission and distribution upgrades. These include the company’s role as a design and consenting service partner in a joint venture with Arup for the UK National Grid’s Great Grid Partnership and its position on EirGrid’s Framework for Grid Development to deliver engineering design, planning and project management services.


*Liam Feeney, Transmission and Distribution Lead, Europe and India, AECOM*


**About AECOM**


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at[aecom.com](https://aecom.com/) .
